test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

AZBZ ∶ CYDY ∶∶ EXFX ∶ GWHW ∶∶ IVJV ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

AZBZ ∶ CYDY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9181d886517ccf077f32306d65fef93539133fd8c01fb3908ccf2f7ef7ec100e.png] 

And

EXFX ∶ GWHW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8db823c842b0e37b80565ae725233e8efea3f423bbc20fbe0ea4324015587c79.png] 

Similarly,

IVJV ∶ ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5caf18a524d083a26e633f7b7349087df878303dcbb50f4585fe4a9af995c913.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"KULU".**

b1:T
